name: dsh-regress-guard
description: Native regress-guard adapter for DeepSeek Harness: typed pre/post-execute, session-start, pre-step and turn-stopping interception plus the /regress-* command surface (ctx.commands.register + followup injection) over the regress-guard python hook chain (single source of truth).
